text: Binary per-row measure from the `argument` column only (the OP's own text, current version including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges a counter-argument to their view or a limitation, weakness or exception of their own position (e.g. "a counterpoint is...", "I admit this may not hold when...", "one weakness of my view is..."; examples not exhaustive); otherwise 0. Does not count mere hedging without naming a counter-argument or limitation, quoted text from other users or opposing positions the OP doesn't adopt, or moderator/bot notices. Ignores as evidence any view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the view changed (including in edits); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant. Does not reconstruct an original snapshot by removing edits. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.
